policy: only datasets.json entries with license_status=APPROVED and eval_only=false; REVIEW_REQUIRED excluded; eval-only sources excluded from training

gsm8k.notes: Grade-school math word problems; ~7.5k train / 1.3k test. MIT verified on the dataset card.

math-competition.notes: MATH dataset (Hendrycks et al.), MIT. Uses a loading script; with datasets>=3 may require trust_remote_code or a parquet mirror. Do not hide a load failure - record a blocker.

sciq.notes: SciQ crowdsourced science MCQ with supporting evidence. Non-commercial license: usable for this research project; do not use commercially.

commercial_use_note: sciq is CC-BY-NC-3.0 (non-commercial); the corpus inherits that restriction
